title: Kalki
desc: Kalki, an intelligent police officer, is assigned to investigate the mysterious murder of Sekhar, the brother of Narsappa, who rules the Kollapuram village.

title: Lucky Baskhar
desc: Desperate to bring his family out of monetary woes, Bhaskar Kumar, a bank employee, enters the dangerous and murky world of financial scams.

title: DNA
desc: Due to their precarious mental health, Divya and Anand's marriage faces numerous challenges that test their relationship.

title: Kaakiyin Vettai
desc: A dedicated police officer struggles to balance his duty to his job and his family obligations when his brother is arrested for murder.

title: Vikram
desc: Mourning cop Vikram and engineer Preethi team up to retrieve and disarm a missile.

title: Maari
desc: Maari, a criminal, constantly troubles the people in his locality and extorts money from them. But his life changes when Sridevi, a pretty woman, falls in love with him.

title: Venky Mama
desc: Venkatarathnam raises Karthik, his orphaned nephew, on his own after the death of his parents. Things change when Karthik suddenly leaves home without notice.

title: Kadal
desc: Unruly Bergman is expelled from his seminary when a kind-hearted fellow student, Sam, exposes his heinous acts. Soon he resolves to teach Sam a lesson that evil does predominate supreme.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Kadavul Irukaan Kumaru
desc: Kumar and his friend decide to celebrate the former's bachelor's party before his wedding. However, chaos ensues when the duo are caught by the police for carrying alcohol.

title: Lucky The Superstar
desc: Lucky, an exceptional and lost puppy, changes the lives of everyone she meets. Finally, she captures the interest of influential political forces, resulting in amusing mayhem and unforeseen upheaval.

title: Aaromaley
desc: An idealistic visionary is compelled to face the reality of life while working at a matrimonial firm. After failing in love due to his negligence, he gets another chance after years.

title: Chandi Veeran
desc: Upon returning to his village, Paari strives to resolve the long-standing water conflict that claimed his father's life years ago.

title: Udanpirappe
desc: Mathangi's husband is a law-abiding citizen while her brother advocates for fighting for justice. As their conflicting beliefs drive them apart, Mathangi struggles to bridge the rift between them.

title: Bharath Ennum Naan
desc: A graduate from Oxford is forced to take up his father's position as the chief minister after his sudden death. Later, he tries to reform the corrupt society but faces obstacles from his enemies.
